lines.en: Did the detectives save the diamonds?
The plane was late and detectives were waiting at the airport all morning.
lines.zh: 飞机晚点了，侦探们在机场等了一上午。

lines.en: They were expecting a valuable parcel of diamonds from South Africa.
lines.zh: 他们正在等一个从南非寄来的贵重钻石包裹。

lines.en: someone had told the police that
thieves would try to steal the diamonds.
lines.zh: 小偷会设法偷走这些钻石。

lines.en: some of the detectives were waiting
while others were waiting on the airfield.
lines.zh: 另一些则在机场跑道上等候。

lines.en: Two men took the parcel off the plane
lines.zh: 两名男子把包裹从飞机上卸下来，

lines.en: and carried it into the Customs House.
While two detectives were keeping guard at the door,
the precious parcel was full of stones and sand!
lines.zh: 这个贵重包裹里装满了石头和沙子！
